title: Eigenvalue Asymptotics in High-Contrast Media
summary: We investigate the eigenfrequency asymptotics of a bounded acoustic cavity containing a shrinking high-contrast inclusion. This configuration is motivated by contrast-enhanced ultrasound imaging, in which microbubbles are employed as acoustic contrast agents. We identify dimension-dependent material scalings that keep the inclusion-induced resonance in a fixed order-one frequency regime as the inclusion shrinks.
